name: np-portal-integration
description: API contract (OpenAPI 3.1) for the portal third-party integration

scripts.bundle: redocly bundle portal@v1 -o dist/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle portal@v1 -o dist/openapi.json
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run bundle && npm run docs
scripts.mock: npm run bundle && prism mock dist/openapi.yaml --port 4010
scripts.mock:dynamic: npm run bundle && prism mock dist/openapi.yaml --port 4010 --dynamic
